instruction: Set Chrome's default font size to Large in the appearance settings.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Chrome and tried to navigate to google.com/preferences to change search results per page. Hit SSL certificate errors (NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID) due to proxy. Spent 50 turns trying curl, terminal debugging, and various URL attempts. Never declared the task as infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome from desktop, type URLs in address bar, use keyboard shortcuts (Enter, F5), open and use terminal, interact with Chrome UI elements (buttons, address bar)
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed on two fronts: (1) SSL cert errors prevented accessing google.com through the proxy, (2) never recognized the task was infeasible (Google doesn't offer a setting to change results per page to 50 via Chrome settings). Model exhausted all 50 turns without declaring [INFEASIBLE].
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to a Chrome local settings task (font size change via chrome://settings/appearance) that doesn't require internet access and is achievable within the model's demonstrated capabilities.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome appearance settings and changing font size to Large (18). Evaluator uses existing chrome_font_size getter to read the Chrome preferences JSON and check_font_size metric to verify the value equals 18.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter get_chrome_font_size correctly reads Chrome Preferences JSON file and returns dict with default_font_size field
Metric check_font_size correctly extracts default_font_size from getter result and compares against expected value using rule type 'value'
Expected value 18 is correct for Chrome's 'Large' font size setting (default is 16/Medium, Large is 18)
No postconfig needed since getter reads directly from the Chrome preferences file on disk, not from UI state
Single-step instruction is fully covered by the single evaluator check
